newsitem.title: USA: Forest Labs says FDA approves Monurol.
newsitem.headline: Forest Labs says FDA approves Monurol.

text.p: Forest Laboratories Inc said on Thursday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration granted marketing clearance to its antibotic Monurol.
The company described the drug as the first one-dose antibiotic for uncomplicated urinary tract infection, a condition that occurs almost exclusively in women.

A single dose of the drug sustains a urinary concentration of active drug for over three and a half days, well above the minimum needed to destroy the most common disease-causing bacteria, Forest Labs said.
